messages:
alex: Heads up — saw an OOM on canary ~10:17 UTC during long-context traffic. Kernel logs point at KV cache growth (many pages retained + fragmentation). Repro signal: 2k->6k token rolling convo with repeated roleplay prompts. Posting heap samples and a short mitigation plan here to sync.
maya: Can you paste the pprof heap sample and which kernel path/model this hit on?
alex: pprof (heap alloc samples):
```
- alloc_objects: kv_page (42%)
- alloc_space: 1.8GB active, ~600MB fragmentation (small free runs)
- hotspots: kv_allocator::alloc_chunk, kvcache_reclaim, kv_page_writeback
```
Model: redwood-30b-quant, kernel chosen: fused-attn-v2 (path B) under heavy batching.

jon: This smells like fragmentation from partial evictions + reuse heuristics not triggering. Short-term mitigations: lower kvcache_max_pages from 95%->80%, enable aggressive reclaim on soft-oom, and cap per-session kv_retention to 4k tokens. Also implement a circuit-breaker that returns 503 + "retry_without_kv" flag for callers when memory pressure high.

sre-bot: incident created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-2217 — alert: kvcache.memory.high; paging events 3x baseline

sam: FYI the batching heuristic interacts here — when batch size spikes we pick v2 kernel which preallocates larger temp buffers (observed 100-300MB transient). Those transient allocs push the allocator into fragmentation territory. Suggestation: tweak kernel selection to prefer v1 for longctx-heavy sessions when active_kv_pages > 10k.

lina: I opened a small patch to force proactive compaction after N evictions: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1832 — compaction threshold configurable. Test plan in PR description, will run quick canary.

maya: Repro script I used (simple):
```
# simulate rolling long-context traffic
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api/redwood/generate -d '{"messages": ["roleplay chunk repeated ..."]}'
  sleep 0.5
done
```
Gives steady growth in kv_pages and fragmentation within ~20-30 minutes.

alex: Proposed rollout plan: apply lina's patch to canary + set configs: kvcache_max_pages=0.80, kvcache_compact_after_evictions=64, kernel_select_pref=prefer_v1_longctx. Monitor heap, fragmentation_ratio, and tail latency for 2 hours. Rollback conditions: OOM rate > 0.1% or p50 latency regression > 15ms. I'll kick off in 10m and post logs.

jon: Also add a metric emit for `kvcache.fragmentation_ratio` (free_fragments/active_alloc) and alert at >0.25. Instrument the allocator hot-paths for event tracing.

maya: Running the repro now and will attach heap-diff and nvtop snapshot. If canary is stable we'll prepare a dedicated backport next week.

alex: Thanks all — tagging @oncall to keep eyes on the canary during the rollout. :pray:
